Name: AT- Furnicolor (Recolors and reinterpretations of furniture)
Author: Amchro
Description:
[size=3][img]https://imgur.com/UMYQlc0.png[/img]﻿﻿
Recolor mod using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] mod. 
Each update will come with the list of items that were recolored.

[color=#f4f4f4]My previous banner mod joins this version (More Banners)[/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9566]

[/url]If there is any doubt let me know.

Other mods I recommend:[list]

[img]https://imgur.com/TVxOxZc.png[/img]
In the main archive there are 4 folders with each pack. Unzip all folders if you want all packs, if you only want one or two you can choose which folder to copy to your mods folder.



[img]https://imgur.com/QSOf1J9.png[/img]
[/size][size=3][b]To recolor you need to buy the Paint Bucket (you can buy it with Robin).
[/b][/size]With the cube select an object from the recolored ones, a window will appear with all the recolored ones.
